name: Sandra Regina Boccia
now: working with group 2 on a personalization feature for the course agent
vibe: Follows the weekly builds closely and joins her group for the week 8 project.
lines: Hi! I'm Sandra. This week I'm with Group 2 on the Course Agent build.
Every week someone builds an agent I didn't know was possible.
My site just says welcome for now. The rest of the class is doing the heavy documenting.
For week 8 I'm with group 2, working on personalizing the course agent.
I like hearing how everyone's agents fail as much as how they work.
